instruction: I need a Rego rule that warns when subject name does not contain digest reference
input:
REQUIREMENTS:
- Package: subject_validation_subject_name
- Rule type: warn
- Purpose: Subject name does not contain digest reference.
- Check: subject name does not contain digest reference

ATTESTATION_SCHEMA:
- input.attestations (array of attestation objects)
  - attestation.statement.predicate (SLSA predicate)
- attestation.statement.subject (array of subjects)
  - subject.name: image reference
  - subject.digest.sha256: image digest

AVAILABLE_HELPERS:
- lib.pipelinerun_attestations: Returns all PipelineRun attestations
- lib.result_helper(chain, terms): Creates violation result
- rego.metadata.chain(): Returns metadata chain for current rule

ANALYSIS:
- Iterate over: subjects
- Check condition: subject name does not contain digest reference
- Result: Report violation with relevant identifiers

RULE:
```rego
package subject_validation_subject_name

import rego.v1

import data.lib

# METADATA
# title: Subject name does not contain digest reference
# description: Subject name does not contain digest reference.
# custom:
#   short_name: subject_name_does
#   failure_msg: "Subject name does not contain digest reference: %s"
#   solution: "Ensure subject name does contain digest reference."
#   collections:
#   - redhat
#
warn contains result if {
	some att in lib.pipelinerun_attestations
	some subject in att.statement.subject
	not contains(subject.name, "@sha256:")
	result := lib.result_helper(rego.metadata.chain(), [subject.name])
}

```
